headline: On last trading day, Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red amid mixed sectoral performance.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Nifty gained 75 points providing some support to the broader market indices.
Sensex slipped into the red following specific sectoral pressures and profit booking.
NTPC terminated a Rs 400 crore storage project, impacting sentiment for GR Infraprojects.
Market participants reacted to mixed global cues and domestic regulatory updates.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen Tuesday.
Paytm shares remained in focus following recent news and opening trade guides.
Nifty 50 managed to close higher by 75 points despite volatility in the Sensex.
Smallcap indices showed varied performance as investors monitored FII activity and crude prices.
